spec.description: Detailed Cisco switch monitoring over SNMP (IF-MIB): port status, traffic, utilization, packet types, errors, and link flaps.

spec.title: SNMP
spec.description: Whether Prometheus can poll the switch over SNMP.

spec.title: Ports Up
spec.description: Interfaces operationally up.

spec.title: Ports Down (enabled)
spec.description: Interfaces administratively enabled but not up — usually nothing connected, or a link problem.

spec.expr: count((ifAdminStatus{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"} == 1) and on (instance, ifIndex) (ifOperStatus{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"} != 1)) or vector(0)

spec.title: Ports Disabled
spec.description: Interfaces shut down by configuration.

spec.title: Total Throughput
spec.description: Combined receive and transmit across selected interfaces (5-minute average).

spec.expr: sum(rate(ifHCInOctets{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[5m]) + rate(ifHCOutOctets{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[5m])) * 8

spec.title: SNMP Poll Time
spec.description: Time taken to poll the switch.

spec.title: Interfaces
spec.description: Every selected interface with state, speed, current traffic, peak utilization (higher of RX/TX), and error/discard rate.

spec.expr: 100 * (rate(ifHCInOctets{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[5m]) > rate(ifHCOutOctets{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[5m]) or rate(ifHCOutOctets{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[5m])) * 8 / (ifHighSpeed{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"} * 1000000 > 0)

rate(ifInErrors{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[5m]) + rate(ifOutErrors{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[5m]) + rate(ifInDiscards{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[5m]) + rate(ifOutDiscards{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[5m])

spec.title: Port State History
spec.description: Operational state of each interface over time — reveals flapping links and outages.

spec.title: Link State Changes
spec.description: Interfaces whose operational state changed during the selected time range. Empty means no flaps.

spec.title: Throughput by Interface
spec.description: Receive above zero, transmit below zero. Only interfaces that are up.

spec.expr: rate(ifHCInOctets{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8 and on (instance, ifIndex) ifOperStatus{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"} == 1

-rate(ifHCOutOctets{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8 and on (instance, ifIndex) ifOperStatus{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"} == 1

spec.title: Top Interfaces
spec.description: Busiest interfaces by combined RX + TX (5-minute average).

spec.expr: topk(10, (rate(ifHCInOctets{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[5m]) + rate(ifHCOutOctets{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[5m])) * 8)

spec.title: Utilization
spec.description: Traffic as a percentage of negotiated link speed.

spec.title: Packets by Type
spec.description: Packet rates across selected interfaces. A sudden broadcast or multicast spike can indicate a loop or storm.

spec.title: Interfaces with Errors
spec.description: Interfaces that logged any input or output errors during the selected time range.

spec.expr: count((increase(ifInErrors{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[$__range]) + increase(ifOutErrors{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[$__range])) > 0) or vector(0)

spec.title: Interfaces with Discards
spec.description: Interfaces that dropped packets (often congestion or buffer exhaustion) during the selected time range.

spec.expr: count((increase(ifInDiscards{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[$__range]) + increase(ifOutDiscards{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[$__range])) > 0) or vector(0)

spec.title: Errors (total in range)
spec.description: Total input and output errors across selected interfaces.

spec.expr: sum(increase(ifInErrors{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[$__range]) + increase(ifOutErrors{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Discards (total in range)
spec.description: Total input and output discards across selected interfaces.

spec.expr: sum(increase(ifInDiscards{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[$__range]) + increase(ifOutDiscards{job="snmp-cisco", instance=~"$instance", ifName=~"$interface"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Errors
spec.description: Only interfaces with non-zero error rates are shown. CRC/input errors usually point to cabling, optics, or duplex mismatch.

spec.title: Discards
spec.description: Only interfaces with non-zero discard rates are shown. Output discards usually mean congestion.

spec.title: Cisco Switch
